name: Ventimiglia (Italy)
description: Yellow field with a broad red lower part charged with a crowned yellow lion rampant (the arms of Ventimiglia).
history: Municipal flag of Ventimiglia, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: narrow yellow stripe above a broad red field
crowned lion rampant on the red
